title: Physics-based phenomenological characterization of cross-modal bias in multimodal models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing emotion classification predictions across combined multimodal (video and audio) versus unimodal (video-only, audio-only) inputs, utilizing prompt-based label perturbation to expose error attractors, and applying dynamical SHAP values on a physics-based multi-oscillator surrogate model to measure modality dominance.
